title: mpi-stuck-guard configuration
description: Configuration for provider stream watchdog, parameter hints and repeated-tool-call protection. Lives at <agentDir>/mpi-stuck-guard.json; missing keys use defaults.

doomLoop.description: Identical calls are checked after canonicalizing JSON keys and require approval or are denied from the third call. Similar calls only warn. Global config, per-session counters; allow disables both detectors.

message.description: Literal text appended only on automatic deny. Preserved but not emitted on allow/ask.

streamWatchdogEnabled.description: Enables or disables provider stream start/idle timeouts.

providerIds.description: Provider IDs to watch; an empty array watches every configured provider.

streamStartTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds before the first provider stream event; 0 disables this timeout.

streamIdleTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds between provider stream events; 0 disables this timeout.

streamRetryStartTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds before the first event after a known timeout in this session; 0 disables the retry start window. Default matches streamStartTimeoutSeconds.

knownTimeoutCooldownSeconds.description: How long this session keeps the retry start window after a watchdog timeout; 0 keeps it for the session lifetime. Not shared across tabs.

similarCallThreshold.description: Same-tool call window for advisory 85% average adjacent argument similarity. Remind at this count, doubled counts and once at the 64-call ceiling; similar calls are never blocked.

schemaHintFailureThreshold.description: Consecutive parameter-validation failures of the same tool before the schema hint is injected.
